## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what users will observe after this change.
Link a related issue if one exists; an issue is not required for a small fix.

## Validation

List tests and manual checks performed. Include synthetic fixtures for detector changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and documented.
- [ ] Core scans remain offline and deterministic.
- [ ] No real credentials or customer data are included.
- [ ] Scoring/schema changes are documented and tested.
- [ ] Lint, formatting, tests, typing and package build pass.
